annotations.title: Ask Dario to contact the user

description: Starts a real contact request for the user. Call ONLY after the user has seen exactly what will be sent and said yes (set userConfirmed true), and use their own name and email. Nothing reaches Dario yet: the user gets an email from darioa with a confirm button and only their click sends it (valid 24 hours); Dario then replies personally, usually within one working day. Repeating the identical call does not send a second email. Returns the WhatsApp link, phone and email for direct contact too. Limits: 5 requests per email address a day; throwaway email addresses are refused.

email.description: The user's own email address; the confirmation email goes here.

locale.description: Language Dario and the confirmation email should use. Default en.

message.description: What the user needs, in a few sentences (include the product and any details from get_quote). Shown to Dario as written.

phone.description: Optional: the user's phone number with country code.

product.description: One of the four products: website, booking (booking site), webshop, webapp (web app).

userConfirmed.description: true only after the user has seen the data above and agreed that Dario may contact them.
